title: HIFD real-data tiny fall classifier (event-centered, precision-first)

selection_policy.tie_break: event-centered F1, then recall; threshold ties -> lower threshold

dataset.name: HIFD (Heart Rate & IMU sensor data for fall detection)
dataset.gyro_units: rad/s (HIFD raw values are deg/s; converted * pi/180)

labels.near_falls: not separately identified; kept in adl

dataset.scenario_source: npz 'scenario' field, derived from subject_XX/{fall,non-fall}/<scenario>.mat paths

label_rule.summary: Only fall recordings are refined. Impact centre p = argmax of a 5-sample centred moving average of the gravity-removed linear acceleration magnitude. Window centre within +-1.0 s of p -> fall; window fully outside p +-1.5 s -> ADL hard negative; remaining 1.0-1.5 s windows excluded. ADL recordings unchanged.

event_detection.signal: sqrt(ax^2 + ay^2 + az^2), m/s^2, gravity removed
event_detection.peak: argmax within each fall recording, ties -> first sample
event_detection.details: computed at train time; not stored per window

window_rule.hard_negative: window_end < p - 75 or window_start > p + 75 (beyond 1.5 s), relabeled adl
window_rule.ambiguous_excluded: any other window in a fall recording; excluded from training and from event-centered window metrics

label_rule.no_synthetic_labels: No fall label is created outside fall/ recordings. Relabeling far windows as ADL uses only the existing recording label plus the impact timing inside that recording.

leakage_check.note: All windows of a subject belong to exactly one split. Adjacent windows overlap by design (stride 25 of 100), only within a split.

validation_event_level.definition: one detection per recording: fall recording is detected if any of its windows has P(fall) >= threshold; ADL recording is a false alarm if any of its windows has P(fall) >= threshold

test_event_level.definition: one detection per recording: fall recording is detected if any of its windows has P(fall) >= threshold; ADL recording is a false alarm if any of its windows has P(fall) >= threshold

candidate_selection.objective: Reduce ADL false positives while keeping event-centered window recall >= 0.90 and event-level recall >= 0.90 on validation.
candidate_selection.decision: event_r50_fall8_hardneg: highest validation event-centered precision among eligible candidates; ties by F1 then recall.

caveats: Trained on real HIFD wrist data only; no synthetic data and no Edge Impulse upload.

The legacy all-window recall is low by construction: pre/post-impact stillness windows are relabeled ADL because they are physically indistinguishable from bed/chair ADL. Legacy recall >= 0.90 with substantially better precision was not achievable under those labels.
Event-level recall (one decision per recording) is the operationally meaningful recall and is reported alongside window metrics.
Event centers come from the largest smoothed acceleration peak inside each fall recording; each HIFD fall recording contains one intentional fall.
HIFD's droll/dpitch/dyaw are deg/s; they were converted to rad/s. The README does not state the unit.
Near-falls are not individually identified in HIFD and remain ADL.
HIFD uses a different wrist sensor and placement than Bio-Band; domain gap remains.
Probabilities are not calibrated; the threshold is a validation-selected operating point.
Research demo only, not a medical device or a safety guarantee.
Some HIFD subject/scenario recordings are missing; see dataset.missing_scenarios.
Metrics come from a single fixed training seed; validation seed sensitivity was observed but not used for selection.
